author: Ronald888888
quote: You know that scene from 25th Hour where Edward Norton rips everyone to their stereotypes including himself. That's what this game needed to be. Instead...well Rockstar will undoubtedly hire a mafia of influencers on Reddit, YouTube, Metacritic in attempt to cover up this colossal failure. Problem is you can't hiee countless videos showing the absurdity of this game. Goodbye Rockstar... at one point you were...alas no more... the star burnt out and collapsed under its own weight.
